items.title: 2.7 Momentum (mass aur velocity ka product) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.7 with Fig. 2.9, Examples 2.6 and 2.7 and the boxes (PDF 38-41, printed 35-38).

blocks.text: Hum jaante hain ke chalti hui cheez mein ek aisi quality (khoobi) hoti hai jis ki wajah se woh har us cheez par force lagati hai jo use rokne ki koshish kare. Cheez jitni tez chal rahi ho, use rokna utna mushkil. Isi tarah agar do cheezen ek hi velocity se chal rahi hon to zyada mass wali (bhaari) ko rokna zyada mushkil hai. Newton ne is quality ko "quantity of motion" kaha. Ab ise linear momentum p⃗ kehte hain, aur is ki definition yeh hai:

Yahan v mass m ki velocity hai. Is liye linear momentum vector quantity hai aur us ki direction wahi hai jo velocity ki. Momentum ka SI unit kilogram metre per second (kg m s⁻¹) hai; ise newton second (N s) bhi likh sakte hain.
Momentum and Newton's Second Law of Motion (momentum aur Newton ka doosra law)

Mass m ki ek body initial velocity v⃗i se chal rahi hai. Us par external (bahar se) force F⃗ time t tak lagti hai, jis ke baad us ki velocity v⃗f ho jati hai. Is force se paida hone wala acceleration:
Newton ke second law se acceleration:
Acceleration ki dono expressions barabar rakhein:
Yahan mv⃗i body ka initial (shuru ka) momentum aur mv⃗f final (aakhri) momentum hai.

blocks.title: Point to Ponder
blocks.text: Kitab mein do pictures hain: (a) paon se patthar ko kick, jis mein contact (choona) 1/100 second rehta hai; (b) football ko kick, jis mein contact 1/10 second rehta hai. Sochein: kis mein zyada chot lagegi, aur kyun?

blocks.title: Point to Ponder
blocks.text: Kya chalti hui cheez mein impulse hota hai?

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Patthar wali kick zyada dukhti hai. Change in momentum taqreeban ek jaisa ho to F = (change in momentum)/t; patthar par contact ka time 10 guna kam hai, is liye paon par force taqreeban 10 guna zyada lagti hai. Aur chalti cheez ke paas momentum hota hai, impulse nahi; impulse tab hota hai jab force kuch time tak lag kar momentum badalti hai.

Equation (2.26) batati hai ke change in momentum = force × woh time jis tak force lagi. Second law ki yeh form F⃗ = ma⃗ se zyada general (har jagah lagne wali) hai, kyun ke is mein woh case bhi aa jata hai jab body accelerate hote hue apna mass bhi badalti ho. Example: rocket accelerate hote hue mass khota hai, kyun ke us ka fuel jal kar thrust (aage dhakelne wali force) dene ke liye bahar nikalta rehta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Aap ke baal skull (khopri) par crumple zone (takkar ka asar kam karne wali tah) ka kaam karte hain. Nangi skull (cranium) taqreeban 5 N ki force se toot sakti hai, lekin skin (jild) aur baalon ke saath taqreeban 50 N chahiye.
Is liye second law momentum ke zariye yun bhi keh sakte hain:
Kisi body ka time rate of change of momentum (momentum kitni tezi se badal raha hai) lagayi gayi force ke barabar hota hai.
Impulse

Kabhi force constant nahi hoti aur bohat thore time ke liye lagti hai. Example: bat jab cricket ball ko marta hai to collision (takkar) ke dauran force har lamhe badalti hai. Aise mein force aur time ko alag alag dekhne ke bajaye un ka product (F⃗ × t) lena aasan hai. Time t tak lagne wali average force F aur t ka product impulse kehlata hai:

blocks.title: Example 2.6
blocks.problem: 1500 kg ki car ki velocity 3.0 s mein 20 m s⁻¹ se kam ho kar 15 m s⁻¹ reh jati hai. Retarding (rokne wali) average force kitni thi?
steps: F = -7500 kg m s⁻¹ / 3.0 s = -2500 kg m s⁻²
blocks.answer: F = -2500 N = -2.5 kN. Negative sign batata hai ke force motion ki ulti direction mein hai, yani rokne wali hai.

blocks.text: Law of Conservation of Momentum (momentum ke conservation, yani qaim rehne, ka law)

Isolated system (alag thalag system) woh system hai jis par bahar se koi force na lage. Example: constant temperature par sheeshe ke bartan mein band gas ke molecules. Molecules apni random (be-tarteeb) motion ki wajah se aapas mein takrate hain, lekin bartan mein band hone ki wajah se koi bahar ki cheez un par force nahi laga sakti.

Ab do smooth (chikni), hard (sakht) balls ka isolated system lein jin ke mass m₁ aur m₂ hain. Dono ek hi straight line mein ek hi direction mein v₁ aur v₂ velocities se chal rahi hain. Woh takrati hain; collision ke baad m₁ velocity v₁′ se aur m₂ velocity v₂′ se usi direction mein chalti hain (Fig. 2.9).

blocks.alt: Teen stages, har ek neeche aur right taraf. Pehle balls m1 aur m2 velocities v1 aur v2 se right taraf chalti hain. Phir balls touch karti hain: m1 par force F' left taraf aur m2 par F right taraf. Aakhir mein woh velocities v'1 aur v'2 se right taraf alag hoti hain.

Action force F⃗ aur reaction force F⃗′ barabar aur ulti hain (Newton ka third law): F⃗′ = -F⃗, yani F⃗ + F⃗′ = 0. Is liye equation ka left side zero hai:
Yani pehli ball ka change in momentum + doosri ball ka change in momentum = 0.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Chalti car achanak ruke to passengers (musafir) windshield ki taraf aage jhuk jate hain. Seatbelt motion ki forces ko badal kar musafiron ko aage jane se rokti hai, is liye chot ka khatra bohat kam ho jata hai.
Matlab: collision se pehle system ka total momentum collision ke baad ke total momentum ke barabar hai. Is liye do balls wale isolated system ke total momentum mein koi change nahi hota.

Aise kisi bhi group mein, agar ek cheez par force lage to usi group ki kisi doosri cheez par barabar aur ulti reaction force zaroor hogi. Result: poore group ka total momentum kabhi nahi badalta. Yahi law of conservation of momentum hai:
Isolated system ka total linear momentum constant rehta hai.
Yeh law lagate waqt yaad rakhein ke momentum vector hai, is liye direction ka sign (+ ya -) zaroor lagayein.

blocks.title: Example 2.7
blocks.problem: 2.0 kg aur 3.0 kg ki do spherical (gol) balls ek doosre ki taraf 6.0 m s⁻¹ aur 4 m s⁻¹ ki velocities se aa rahi hain. Collision ke baad bari ball ki velocity 3.0 m s⁻¹ ho to chhoti ball ki velocity kya hogi?
steps: Balls aamne saamne aa rahi hain, is liye un ki velocities ke sign ulte hain. 2 kg ball ki direction positive aur 3 kg ball ki negative lein.
Collision se pehle momentum: m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ = 2 kg × 6 m s⁻¹ + 3 kg × (-4 m s⁻¹) = 12 kg m s⁻¹ - 12 kg m s⁻¹ = 0
Collision ke baad momentum: m₁v₁′ + m₂v₂′ = 2 kg × v₁′ + 3 kg × (-3 m s⁻¹)
Conservation se: pehle ka momentum = baad ka momentum, yani 0 = 2 kg × v₁′ - 9 kg m s⁻¹
blocks.answer: v₁′ = 4.5 m s⁻¹ (positive; kitab bari ball ki baad wali velocity -3 m s⁻¹ leti hai, yani bari ball apni pehli direction mein hi chalti rehti hai, aur chhoti ball bhi apni pehli direction (positive) mein 4.5 m s⁻¹ se chalti hai)

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Motorcycle ke safety helmet mein padding (gaddi) is liye hoti hai ke collision ka time lamba ho jaye aur sakht chot na lage.

blocks.prompt: 20 g ki gend squash court ki deewar se 0.50 s tak 50 N ki constant force se takrati hai; impulse nikalein. Ek footballer 0.25 s tak 240 N ki average force lagata hai; change in momentum aur us ki direction batayein. Seatbelt aur helmet chot kyun kam karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Impulse = F × t = 50 N × 0.50 s = 25 N s (mass ki zaroorat nahi). Change in momentum = 240 N × 0.25 s = 60 N s = 60 kg m s⁻¹, us direction mein jis taraf force lagi (jahan kick maari). Helmet ki padding aur seatbelt momentum badalne ka time lamba kar dete hain; momentum ke utne hi change ke liye average force F = (mvf - mvi)/t kam ho jati hai.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: p⃗ = mv⃗ (kg m s⁻¹ = N s), vector. F⃗ × t = mv⃗f - mv⃗i: force = momentum badalne ka rate (yeh form badalte mass par bhi lagti hai). Impulse = F × t = change in momentum (Example 2.6: -2.5 kN).
Conservation: isolated system mein F⃗′ = -F⃗, is liye m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ = m₁v₁′ + m₂v₂′; total linear momentum constant rehta hai (sign ka khayal rakhein). Example 2.7: v₁′ = 4.5 m s⁻¹.
